open.speaker: Margaret
open.text: I kept this in the desk until the benediction. The plate from this morning will not cover the oil bill. The account was already short before you arrived.

deposits.speaker: Margaret
deposits.text: Some months there's a deposit from an account I don't recognize. Always the week before a council vote.

harold.speaker: Harold
harold.text: I knew we were thin. I did not know the year had been papered over. We tell them when we have a true sentence, not a panic.

close.speaker: Margaret
close.text: That is the end of the first week. Not the end of the church. We will need a plan, and we will need it said out loud.
